definition: Ben Goertzel is a computer scientist, artificial intelligence (AI) researcher, and businessman.
details: He helped popularize the term artificial general intelligence (AGI).
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Ben Goertzel — a small key that opens a big door.
